items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, affiliate, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data-handling boundaries. Evidence: SearchWoot rights are not established; all four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open; security and accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Technical compliance is 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown and is not certification. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; permit only existing read-only evidence work. No go-live proposal is supported. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, public/commercial data use, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Progress: 0/4 launch-readiness tasks closed; 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task can close because direct evidence for field rights, retention, deletion/correction/access, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback remains incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted storage, caching, display, derivative, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table including Slack delivery. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or customer matching. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident, subpoena, and data-subject request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory and route unresolved gaps to human counsel.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence for each site.

Continue existing repair-or-close, deployed-change measurement, finance reconciliation, and security evidence work only. Do not create new queue work, retry unchanged failures, add telemetry, expand monetization, or make unsupported revenue, ROI, attribution, or causal-lift claims. The only supported revenue result is $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21, not site-attributable.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps remain unavailable and all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Preserve private gates and block public exposure and security-sensitive releases. Do not access credentials, change permissions, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, or conduct outreach.
